strings.name: Oleksandra Matviichuk
strings.role: Human rights lawyer · Civil liberties leader
strings.summary: Matviichuk combines legal aid, civic organizing and documentation of alleged war crimes. She leads the Center for Civil Liberties, coordinated Euromaidan SOS and helped launch accountability initiatives. Her organization shared the 2022 Nobel Peace Prize. In 2026 she discussed democracy and resilience during war in Stockholm.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Leads Ukraine’s Center for Civil Liberties, advancing war-crime documentation and human-rights protection; the organization received the Nobel Peace Prize.
